messages:
amy (pm): FYI we got a request from AtlasPay for a cost-sensitive staged rollout of the new pricing recommendation flow. Requirements: tenant-only flag, A/B for conversion, per-tenant token cap, and an instant quiet-fallback to the legacy UI. Also need audit trail and a named on-call for the first 36h.

ben (eng): Proposal: flag `pricing.recs.v1` with values off/control/variant and a tenant override for AtlasPay. Start at 1% experiment exposure -> 5% -> 20% if stable. Implement a lightweight fallback `recs.v1-lite` using cached prefixes and lower quantization.

carlos (sre): Canary plan: 1h with 5m buckets. Monitors: p95 latency, 5xx, token_burn_per_min, and conversion delta. Circuit-breaker: error_rate >= 0.5% OR p95 > 1400ms OR token_burn > budget*1.25 for 3 buckets -> flip to lite and alert. Also require a per-tenant throttler to prevent runaway cost.

zoe (sales): AtlasPay legal wants clear rollback SLAs and a customer-facing note if we enable feature for >5% users. They also want audit export to their S3 with KMS. I'll confirm contact and S3 path.

ben (eng): Routing snippet for fallback behavior: 
```yaml
flag: pricing.recs.v1
routes:
  - match: tenant=="atlaspay" && flag=="variant"
    route_to: recs_v1
    on_error: recs_v1-lite
    cost_protect: true
```
This prevents requeueing onto expensive infra after fallback.

carlos (sre): Add trace tag `canary=pricing_recs_v1` and golden-run eval every 15m comparing control/variant on a small prompt set. If quality regresses -> rollback. We'll also push webhooks to AtlasPay ops channel on auto-fallback.

amy (pm): Go/no-go gates after initial 1h: conversion uplift >= +1.5% OR no regression beyond -0.5%, p95 delta <= +150ms, token delta <= +12%. If any gate fails -> immediate rollback and postmortem.

zoe (sales): I'll schedule pre-launch call 2026-09-14 and get the KMS/S3 details.

carlos (sre): Will draft runbook and circuit-breaker PR today.

ben (eng): Will open flag + routing PR and cheap-mode PR.

amy (pm): Action list: Ben flag & cheap-mode, Carlos CB + runbook, Zoe legal & S3 details. React with :thumbsup: when PRs are linked. Closing once links present.
